Coram : ABHAY S. OKA*, UJJAL BHUYAN
Issue for Consideration Issue as regards the shares of the parties in the disputed land. High Court whether justified in upholding the order passed by the Deputy Director of Consolidation in revision and holding that the appellants had 1/12 share jointly in the plots comprised in Khata Nos. plot Nos. 35, 37, 111 and 112 which exclusively belonged to the respondents. Consolidation authorities whether erred in alloting 1/2 share to the predecessor-in-interest of the appellants. Headnotes† Uttar Pradesh Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953 – ss.9(2), 11(1) – High
Decision Date : 24-10-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9739/2011 | Direction Issue : Civil Appeals dismissed. Contempt Petition closed. | Bench : 2 Judges
